messages:
Ravi: Heads up  QuickOak procurement emailed. They want PO before countersign, DocuSign routing by tax ID, and pushed HSM language in the MSA.
Hannah: I saw the redlines. Legal: HSM warranty = no-go. Offer attestation + SOC2. Replace binding language with 'commercially reasonable efforts'.
Diego: POC team asks for a trial performance note so infra can approve. Recommend a non-binding POC appendix instead of MSA edits.
Asha: Finance flags Net60 as unacceptable. Offer Net30 or 30% prepay + Net30. If they insist on Net60, need RevOps OK.
Ravi: They also want EU log residency noted. Can we region-pin the trial and redact logs?
EngBot: ENG ticket created: ENG-9987 to enable eu-west-1 pin + trial log redaction.
Hannah: I'll prep a redacted KMS attestation PDF and attach SOC2 summary. Legal will draft the reply language.
Diego: Draft appendix (non-binding): ```POC appendix: p50 < 160ms, p95 < 520ms for seq_len<=1024 on provisioned trial capacity subject to availability. Metrics via Redwood Console. Informational only.```
Asha: Good. Also ask them to provide billing contact + PO up front; Finance will delay otherwise.
Ravi: DocuSign routing they requested: QuickOak legal -> QuickOak CFO -> QuickOak procurement -> Redwood Legal -> Redwood RevOps. Envelope must include PO and billing fields.
Hannah: That routing looks OK. Use redwood-esign@redwood.com for internal recipients. Remove internal-only exhibits before sending.
Ravi: I'll send updated order form with Net30 or 30% prepay + Net30 options, attach POC appendix and attestation links, and request billing contact + PO. Will update when they reply. :thumbsup:
